create_LocoMCAgent_subclass: create a subclass of LocoMCAgent that implements init_physical_interfaces for movement and chat
implement_init_perception: implement init_perception to define get_pos and get_incoming_chats methods for the agent
implement_init_controller: implement init_controller to set up an NSPDialogueManager with dialogue object classes
run_task_step: run task_step on the agent to process the topmost task from the memory task stack
run_controller_step: run controller_step to process incoming chats and update the dialogue manager and task stack
